verdict.rationale: GA4 documents exporting all raw events to BigQuery, with continuous intra-day export plus a daily full export, and SQL-like querying there. The Admin API exposes a bigQueryLinks resource, and a community user confirms it "hooks into BigQuery easily." missing for 10: export destinations beyond BigQuery (e.g., other warehouses), in-product querying of warehouse tables, and detail on continuous-export latency/limits (the bigQueryLinks API is only v1alpha).

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)

citations.quote: You can export all of your raw events from Google Analytics properties ... to BigQuery, and then use an SQL-like syntax to query that data.
Data is also exported continuously throughout the day.
It hooks into BigQuery easily (a few bucks a month)
